interactives.label: Rules of the cut
interactives.text: One party at a time. The dead wake at the quarry mouth. Waystones count you out. The court is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The quarry
interactives.text: The lens grinders cut here for songstone until the cut began to answer the hammers. Nobody has quarried since. Everything else has.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Resonant Cut
gauntlet.flavour: A quarry cut into the singing rock and abandoned when the rock sang back.
